learnings.learning: When restructuring an Electron app into a 'src' folder, ensure that 'package.json' 'main' entry point is updated and all internal paths (preload, icon, loadFile) are correctly adjusted relative to the new file locations.
Separating styles into specific files (layout, header, status, etc.) improves maintainability, but it's crucial to verify all files are actually created and properly imported in the main style file.
